seeds.sg-3-0-0-0: You step onto the splintered green causeway of the First Shard, where jagged towers lean like broken teeth against the glare.
seeds.sg-3-0-0-1: A low murmur rises from the glass-shingle dunes as a string of laden pack-mules picks its way past an ash-filled courtyard.
seeds.sg-3-0-0-2: You duck beneath an arch of fused obsidian while high above, a Glasswright mirror flashes a sharp warning across the basin.
seeds.sg-3-0-0-3: The salty wind whistles through hollow window frames of translucent crystal, chilling your fingers around the cold ceramic Seedkey in your pocket.
seeds.sg-3-0-1-0: A barefoot scraper named Mallow crouches by a heap of ruby slag, offering to trade a scrap of dried melon for your coal-lantern.
seeds.sg-3-0-1-1: Salt Court sentries bar the narrow alley with a brass-bound gate, demanding a silver penny or three hours of your labor to pass.
seeds.sg-3-0-1-2: A cantilevered glass bridge shimmers above a dry trench, its transparent span humming whenever the midday heat makes the joints contract.
seeds.sg-3-0-1-3: Two scavengers argue over a heap of copper wire inside a gutted observatory, ignoring the blinding glare reflected off the dome above.
seeds.sg-3-0-1-4: You crawl through a subterranean drainage pipe lined with green sea-glass, emerging into a choked courtyard smelling of stagnant sulfur.
seeds.sg-3-0-1-5: A solitary Glasswright on a high stone balcony swings a brass heliograph mirror, flashing a silent code that makes your temples throb.
seeds.sg-3-0-1-6: A tethered goat belonging to a nomadic well-keeper chews on a strip of canvas near a dry stone basin where a trickle of brackish water gathers.
seeds.sg-3-0-1-7: Shard-dust grinds beneath your boots as you cross an open plaza where the skeletons of ancient trees are preserved entirely in milky quartz.
seeds.sg-3-0-1-8: Recognizing your unburdened hands and untied debts, an old lens-grinder points out a hidden maintenance hatch that bypasses the toll-fort completely.
seeds.sg-3-0-1-9: A heavy iron portcullis blocks the mouth of the sunken street, guarded by a bored Salt Court bailiff who polishes his brass knuckles with a rag.
seeds.sg-3-0-2-0: You climb a spiral stair of green vitrified brick that winds inside a hollow spire, emerging onto a narrow walkway overlooking a sea of jagged glass.
seeds.sg-3-0-2-1: A dust-caked vendor named Vane sells roasted locusts from a bronze brazier, muttering about the strange lights dancing nightly over the central observatory.
seeds.sg-3-0-2-2: You squeeze through a narrow fissure between two leaning glass tenements, feeling the sharp edges of amethyst panes pluck at your travel-worn tunic.
seeds.sg-3-0-2-3: A battered handcart laden with scrap mirrors blocks your route, its wooden wheels jammed tight with fused sand and sharp fragments of green bottle-glass.
seeds.sg-3-0-2-4: You cross a courtyard paved with mosaic tiles of blue cobalt glass that ring like tiny bells under the rhythmic crunch of your heavy boots.
seeds.sg-3-0-2-5: A hollow bronze pipe extends from a ruined facade, leaking a steady drip of lukewarm, mineral-heavy water into a chipped stone basin below.
seeds.sg-3-0-2-6: A group of children toss polished glass marbles against a leaning wall, pausing their game to stare at the faint orange glow of your hidden lantern.
seeds.sg-3-0-2-7: You navigate a perilous ledge of translucent roofing tiles, watching the dry basin floor drop away into dizzying depths fifty feet below.
seeds.sg-3-0-2-8: A toll-lord's clerk sits behind a makeshift desk of slate and timber, demanding proof of water-tax payment before you cross the boundary stone.
seeds.sg-3-0-2-9: You slip behind a curtain of hanging copper chains inside a deserted workshop, avoiding the sharp eyes of a passing Salt Court patrol squad.
seeds.sg-3-0-2-10: A pale scavenger named Thistle offers to trade a map drawn on salted hide for a single pinch of dried tobacco from your pouch.
seeds.sg-3-0-2-11: Noting the Dune Sisters' sacred seal inked on your wrist, a cautious well-guard unlocks a private postern gate and waves you through without a toll.
seeds.sg-3-0-2-12: You haul yourself up a frayed hemp rope dangling from a shattered second-story balcony to escape a sudden gust of stinging alkaline dust.
seeds.sg-3-0-3-0: A headless bronze statue of an Old Lensfolk magistrate stands in a weed-choked plaza, its outstretched arm pointing toward a narrow tunnel of dark glass.
seeds.sg-3-0-3-1: The steady amber radiance of your coal-lantern catches the glint of a dropped brass gear, revealing a hidden crawlspace beneath the cobblestones.
seeds.sg-3-0-3-2: A blind glass-blower named Kestrel sits by a smoking brazier, tapping a small singing bowl that emits a pure, high note echoing down the empty street.
seeds.sg-3-0-3-3: You dodge a shower of glittering shards as a brittle upper balcony collapses under the relentless heat of the mid-afternoon sun.
seeds.sg-3-0-3-4: A tethered desert hound bares its teeth from a vine-wrapped courtyard, straining against a rusty chain anchored to a massive block of green slag.
seeds.sg-3-0-3-5: You step across a threshold of polished obsidian into a cool, domed vestibule where the air smells faintly of old parchment and dried lavender.
seeds.sg-3-0-3-6: A trio of Salt Court tax-collectors lounge by a dry fountain, drinking tepid goat milk from earthenware jugs while watching the perimeter walls.
seeds.sg-3-0-3-7: You squeeze through a jagged window frame into a weaver's loft strewn with tangled threads of spun glass that glitter like frozen cobwebs.
seeds.sg-3-0-3-8: A rusted iron signboard swings on a single hinge above a boarded doorway, groaning rhythmically in the dry wind blowing off the salt flats.
seeds.sg-3-0-3-9: You balance on a narrow cedar beam bridging a deep gap between two leaning glass towers, keeping your eyes fixed firmly on the far wall.
seeds.sg-3-0-3-10: A hooded scavenger pokes through a mound of ash with a long iron spit, unearthing a string of heavy ceramic beads that clink softly together.
seeds.sg-3-0-3-11: You pause within the shadow of a colossal solar mirror, feeling its immense curved surface radiate residual heat long after the sun has shifted.
seeds.sg-3-0-3-12: A ragged urchin darts out from behind a stack of empty crates, thrusting a bruised yellow plum toward you before scurrying back into the gloom.
seeds.sg-3-0-4-0: You descend a steep flight of stone steps slick with white salt crust, entering a subterranean marketplace echoing with the low murmur of tradesmen.
seeds.sg-3-0-4-1: A towering gate of riveted iron plates bars the end of the corridor, guarded by two veterans wearing breastplates fashioned from recycled green bottle-glass.
seeds.sg-3-0-4-2: You slip through a narrow gap behind a stack of salted fish crates, emerging into a bustling alleyway lit by flickering tallow dips.
seeds.sg-3-0-4-3: A nervous archivist named Fenn sorts through stacks of damp ledgers inside a pillared portico, muttering about missing seals and fraudulent water deeds.
seeds.sg-3-0-4-4: You cross a dry canal bed on a footbridge made of interlaced willow branches, listening to the dry reeds rattle in the hot afternoon draft.
seeds.sg-3-0-4-5: A broad plaza opens before you, its center dominated by a dry stone fountain where travelers gather to trade gossip and fill their waterskins.
seeds.sg-3-0-4-6: You squeeze past a team of sweating laborers hauling a massive quartz lens on a wooden sledge through the narrowing commercial thoroughfare.
seeds.sg-3-0-4-7: A brightly painted canvas awning flaps wildly above a crowded spice stall, casting shifting patterns of shadow across the sun-bleached flagstones.
seeds.sg-3-0-5-0: You step into the chaotic clamour of the Rumour Market, where merchants hawk dubious tales and travelers crowd around competing information stalls.
seeds.sg-3-0-5-1: The air hums with urgent whispers as rival factions trade conflicting stories about the sealed gates and hidden water levels of the Rain Vault.
seeds.sg-3-0-5-2: You push through a throng of arguing traders and bickering scribes, seeking a quiet corner to weigh the conflicting reports before choosing your path.
seeds.sg-3-0-5-3: Standing at the heart of the bustling market square, you prepare to hear the twin rumors that will determine your next desperate move forward.
